text:
Intermediate-layer aggregation and adaptive depth are established. [Jumping Knowledge Networks](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/xu18c/xu18c.pdf) combine intermediate representations through concatenation, coordinatewise max, or input-dependent LSTM attention. [ELMo](https://aclanthology.org/N18-1202.pdf) learns task-specific scalar layer weights shared across inputs; contextual representations do not make its mixing weights input-conditioned. [SkipRec](https://cdn.aaai.org/ojs/16518/16518-13-20012-1-2-20210518.pdf) already makes sequence-dependent retain/skip decisions for NextItNet blocks, while its NextItNet+ backbone explicitly uses zero-initialized learnable residual coefficients. [ReZero](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v161/bachlechner21a/bachlechner21a.pdf) establishes this residual-scaling principle more generally; its learned scalars are input-independent.

The proposed score z_kᵀdiag(w_k)q = w_kᵀ(z_k ⊙ q) is a diagonal bilinear interaction between a layer representation and recent-item anchor. Its plausible distinction is this particular conditioning signal and parameterization for soft intermediate-layer aggregation. Unlike SkipRec, aggregation alone does not skip computation. Assessment: more differentiated than scalar residual correction, which has a direct NextItNet+ precedent, but insufficient evidence for a substantially higher originality rating; adaptive aggregation and personalized depth already exist, and these sources do not establish novelty of the exact anchor interaction.

Controlled ablations should hold backbone, residual scaling, readout, training budget, and evaluator fixed: final-layer-only; uniform aggregation; learned static scalar mixing; z-only gates; q-only gates; additive z/q gates; diagonal bilinear gates. Compare recent-item q against pooled-history, constant, and shuffled anchors. Match gate capacity where practical, and cross static/conditioned aggregation with residual scaling enabled/disabled. Gate shuffling or replacement by mean weights at inference tests reliance on conditioning. Report per-category and macro validation HR@10, gate variability, and entropy; attention variation alone does not establish useful depth selection. Train each variant independently, with one model per category.
